summary: Air Industries Group (AIR) filed an 8-K announcing an amended and restated merger agreement to acquire Tenax Aerospace Acquisition, LLC. Under the terms, AIR will issue 126.9 million shares (25.38 million post-1-for-5 reverse split) as consideration, with a debt-adjusted share price of $3.05 ($15.25 post-split). Post-closing, Tenax members will own ~96% of AIR common stock, with pre-closing AIR stockholders owning ~4%. No exchange ratio, premium, or break fee is specified. The transaction is a reverse merger creating a change of control. Watch for shareholder approval and charter amendment effectiveness; risk-arb centers on post-split valuation and regulatory clearance.
